_comment: Reference values for ltem-fish-biomass skill at Cabo Pulmo (benchmark MPA). Used for validation — output must be within tolerance. Values extracted from LTEM survey data (Cabo Pulmo is the best-monitored and most-recovered MPA in the Pacific Mexico system).
_units: T/ha (tonnes per hectare). Note: internal LTEM database stores biomass in T/ha.

kpi_mean_biomass_tpha.description: 5-year mean fish biomass. Cabo Pulmo shows some of the highest values among monitored Mexican MPAs. Reference: ~0.09 T/ha (≈ 9 g/m²). Compare: adjacent unprotected reefs typically 0.005–0.015 T/ha.

trend_direction.description: Fish biomass at Cabo Pulmo has shown a positive recovery trend since full protection was established (1995). GAM trend should be non-decreasing across the time series.

min_survey_years.description: Cabo Pulmo has one of the longest time series in the LTEM network. Expect ≥15 annual survey years in the database.

context.recovery_description: Cabo Pulmo is the gold standard of MPA recovery in Mexico. A 2011 Science paper (Aburto-Oropeza et al.) documented a 463% increase in fish biomass relative to adjacent unprotected reefs 10 years after full protection.
context.note_haemulidae: Haemulidae (grunts) are excluded from the functional group breakdown per LTEM protocol (colonial schooling species that inflate biomass estimates), but included in total biomass.
